name: Virginia permits: second reading
what_was_checked: All 182 readable permits on DEQ's statewide list of datacenter air permits
method: Re-read by a second method that shares no code with the first; every permit read by eye with hand re-summation; disagreements resolved against the permit text
checker: second reader working separately from the first
result: The first reading agreed with the text in 24 permits; 107 disagreed (the first reading low in 98), 22 differed slightly and 29 gave no figure. Eight error patterns were found, the largest a first row dropped after each table header (70 permits). Resolved total 33,693 MW for 182 permits; the first reading gave 19,186 MW for 153, which resolve to 30,867 MW. The fixed parser agrees with the resolved figures on 178 of 182, a test of the parser, not a third reading.

name: Hostile methodology review of the handover
what_was_checked: The brief, the Ireland regional check, the five worked rows, the dedicated-supply column and the method
method: A reviewer taking the stance of a methodology lead looking for a reason to set the package aside
result: 36 findings: 4 blocked sending, 18 to fix before sending, 10 caveats, 4 fine. The five worked rows were withdrawn; the Ireland check became a table of bounds; the supply column was reclassified.

name: Final review of the package and brief

result: 37 findings: 4 blocked sending, 16 to fix before sending, 14 caveats, 3 fine.

result: 51 findings: 5 blocked linking the page, 27 to fix before sending, 12 caveats, 7 fine; the page's own prose said more than the entries.
